title: Pure Shark
summary: Shark monsters and the WATER Xyz Monsters they climb into, with generic staples. Bahamut Shark is Forbidden. Buzzsaw and Lantern Shark pull or summon a second Fish, and most Sharks can be treated as Level 3, 4 or 5 for a WATER Xyz, so they make Rank 4s and Rank 5s on demand. The modern engine leads: Veiss Shark, the newest card, Tributes a Fish to summon another Shark from the Deck, Surfacing Big Jaws and Drake Shark search and count double, and Number C32: Shark Drake LeVeiss stacks on a Rank 4 Shark Drake and inherits the Sharks' negates.
